name: Muse Code
description: Meta's first AI coding agent, a terminal-based system designed for large codebases. Powered by the Muse Spark 1.2 model, it can inspect entire repositories, create plans, and modify multiple files. Available for macOS and Linux as a beta tool.
community_quotes: Meta's entry into the terminal-native AI coding space to compete with Claude Code and OpenAI Codex
Like having a software engineer in your terminal
Designed for complex software development workflows with persistent AI agents
